verdict.rationale: The official quickstart explicitly promises a first API call in under a minute with SDKs for Python, JS/TS, Go, and Java (gemini-docs-19, gemini-docs-13), which matches the story closely. However, independent developer reports describe real friction reaching that first successful call — restrictive free-tier rate limits requiring prior Cloud spend, multi-week 'warm up' periods before higher quotas unlock, and unexpectedly complex account/billing setup that deterred some developers entirely (gemini-comm-1, gemini-comm-2, gemini-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the quickstart itself completes in minutes without hitting these account-tier obstacles, and resolution of the documented onboarding friction.
